external_reference_standard.admission_rule: A kernel compute ratio is not a system speedup. DATE-level headline admission requires an integrated workload schedule, accuracy, memory traffic, PPA/power/energy and like-for-like baselines.

dc_sta.wire_and_clock_scope: ZeroWireload, ideal clock, standalone logic, no SRAM macro

formality.note: The unmatched report was emitted after matching but before the long verify command, explaining its earlier timestamp; the same process later produced verification SUCCEEDED.

m43_findings.admitted_claim: Fresh exact-SHA standalone logic-only 3ns DC/STA/Formality and implemented peak 768 signed adds/cycle, with 8661.872080 signed adds/cycle/mm2 at this pre-macro scope.
m43_findings.not_admitted: placed/routed PPA, SRAM-inclusive area, power, energy, full-network cycles or speedup, measured K2 dual-destination hardware, accuracy, external accelerator comparison or DATE headline

directed_vcs.full_eight_reason: The accepted event asserts all eight source-valid bits; every slot has exactly one positive or negative mask bit for every pixel, all 96 output lanes are checked against the independent golden accumulator, and SVA records one accepted full-eight hit.

premacro_dc.wire_and_clock_scope: ZeroWireload, ideal clock, standalone logic, no SRAM macro

m62_findings.admitted_claim: Exact-SHA directed VCS/SVA for the P48x2 S8 signed13 prediction-head lane-fold datapath; separately, an unsealed 3ns pre-macro DC report set for the same currently observed RTL bytes.
m62_findings.not_admitted: real-trace equivalence, valid825 quantized accuracy, Formality, sealed PPA, power, energy, memory, full-network cycles/speedup, 3.086x system speedup or DATE headline

P1.finding: The 3ns DC reports are numerically plausible and internally terminal, but the run has no exact-SHA additive DC contract, frozen input snapshot, rc receipt, output manifest/completion seal, independent validator or Formality result. It analyzed a live source path. The directed-VCS contract explicitly forbids DC/STA/Formality admission, so the later reports require a new contract rather than silent scope expansion.
P1.impact: Do not cite 0.035459 mm2 or 3ns as sealed M62 PPA/equivalence evidence.
P1.minimal_fix: Create an additive exact-SHA M62 DC/STA/Formality contract binding RTL, VCS receipt, SDC, filelist, libraries and tools; snapshot inputs, rerun or seal a fresh foreground run, complete Formality, emit receipt, completion seal, validator and tamper attacks.

P1.finding: 3.086389x is dense work divided by bounded signed-event-plus-commit work for one prediction-head kernel. The artifacts currently label it correctly, but M62 has not measured that ratio in RTL cycles and the terminal head's fraction of whole-network latency is not established.
P1.impact: The number cannot be used as an accelerator or end-to-end speedup headline.
P1.minimal_fix: Map all ten ordered traces through the RTL service schedule, include command/event/commit/backpressure and memory costs, publish per-sample cycles and Amdahl composition, then compare against equal-resource fixed, Prosperity and Phi-like baselines.

P1.finding: M43 and M62 are separate standalone kernels with different interfaces and accumulator widths. There is no shared scheduler, address-timed SRAM/DRAM trace, resource arbitration, simultaneous area budget, or cycle conservation proving that their benefits compose.
P1.impact: Areas, peaks and opportunity ratios cannot be added into a single accelerator result.
P1.minimal_fix: Integrate both exact RTL blocks behind one cycle/transaction model and common memory/resource contract, then VCS-replay the ordered all10 workload with per-module and system counters.

P1.finding: Unlike Prosperity/Phi, the current pair lacks SRAM/DRAM cost, CACTI or macro results, SAIF/PTPX power, placed/routed timing, end-to-end accuracy and like-for-like accelerator baselines.
P1.impact: The combined evidence is not yet a DATE-complete accelerator evaluation.
P1.minimal_fix: Close integrated cycles first, then add memory macros/CACTI, DRAMsim3, SAIF/PTPX, placed or at least physically informed timing, accuracy and normalized throughput/energy/area tables.

P2.finding: The M62 receipt calls 240 groups random, but the testbench uses deterministic arithmetic patterns and no random generator.
P2.minimal_fix: Rename them deterministic generated legal groups or add a frozen-seed constrained-random campaign.

P2.finding: Only orphan-event protocol rejection is attacked; overlap masks, invalid-slot masks, reserved -128 weights, no-signed-work events and accumulator overflow are not independently attacked.
P2.minimal_fix: Add fail-closed directed attacks with exact expected first-failure causes and sticky-fault checks.

P2.finding: The full-eight cover is valid but represents one accepted event and one mask/weight construction.
P2.minimal_fix: Add sign-extreme, sparse-per-slot, dense-per-slot, near-overflow seed and backpressured full-eight cases.

P2.finding: formality_unmatched.rpt is generated before verify and therefore has an earlier timestamp than the terminal reports; the result is not invalid, but it is easy for an external reviewer to misread as mixed evidence.
P2.minimal_fix: Regenerate all diagnostic reports after verify in the next sealed run or document report ordering in the receipt.

P2.finding: Both RTLs produce explicit signed/unsigned conversion warnings. M43 Formality closes them, while M62 lacks Formality.
P2.minimal_fix: Use explicit signed casts and preserve bit-exact VCS/Formality results.

one common M43+M62 address/cycle/resource model with no double-counted area or bandwidth
all10 ordered-trace VCS or exact transaction replay with per-sample command, event, response, output, stall and cycle conservation
p50/p95/p99 and ratio-of-totals cycles versus equal-resource Fixed, RQTB, Prosperity and Phi-like adapters
